# The city's second brain (generated by scripts/brain.py, do not edit)

Skills = how-tos the agents learned. Read the ones that match your job in brain/skills/<slug>.md before
you start. If you work out something reusable that isn't here, add a skill (see learn-a-skill).

## Skills
- add-city-building: Add a building to the city [city, three.js, upgrade, index.html] (agents: coder)
- betting-model-learning: Improve the self-learning betting model [bets, nfl, nba, calibration, walk-forward, learning] (agents: coder, quant)
- budget-template: Make a budget or planning template [budget, money, template, spreadsheet, csv] (agents: planner, runner, scribe)
- cad-model: Make a working 3D model for CAD Studio [cad, 3d, model.json, mechanism, stl] (agents: cad)
- city-camera-controls: Change how you move around the city (camera controls) [city, three.js, camera, orbitcontrols, mobile, touch, keyboard, upgrade] (agents: coder)
- escalate-one-hop: Pick the cheapest agent, escalate once [routing, cost, escalate, tiers] (agents: analyst, cad, coder, forge, planner, quant, runner, scout, scribe, tutor)
- learn-a-skill: Teach the brain a new skill [brain, memory, learning, skills, meta] (agents: analyst, cad, coder, forge, planner, quant, runner, scout, scribe, tutor)
- mcp-connector: Build an MCP connector [mcp, connector, server, api, typescript, security] (agents: forge, scout)
- pause-and-resume: Survive a usage limit mid-job [progress, checkpoint, resume, limits] (agents: analyst, cad, coder, forge, quant)
- quick-answer: Give a quick, exact answer [math, answer, lookup] (agents: runner)
- secure-public-fetch: Fetch user-given public URLs safely [security, fetch, ssrf, dns, redirects, mcp] (agents: coder, forge)
- static-job-page: Ship an app as a static page [web, html, app, game, dashboard, github-pages] (agents: coder, quant)
- stock-signal-model: Build a stock buy/sell signal model [stocks, quant, backtest, signals, market] (agents: quant)

## Tools
- scripts/brain.py: The city's second brain: turns skills, agents, tools and job history into one web. Free: no model calls
- scripts/cad_check.py: Checks an Agent City CAD model (agent-city-cad/1, see cad/SCHEMA.md). No model calls, stdlib only
- scripts/city_job.py: Runs one Agent City job inside GitHub Actions. Called by .github/workflows/city-job.yml
- scripts/city_resume.py: Restarts jobs that were paused by a Claude usage limit, once the limit has reset
- scripts/city_schedule.py: Hourly check for recurring Agent City jobs (free: no model calls)
- scripts/market_data.py: Fresh daily price history with no API key and no third-party packages
- scripts/signals.py: Daily market signals for the watchlist. Pure Python, zero Claude usage
- cad/: Opens and checks 3D models (model.json)
- bets/: Self-learning NFL/NBA model behind the Lucky Tower
- watchlist.json: Tickers the free daily market scan follows
